artworks.title: Letter W
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the letter "W" illustrated with a skeleton and a hooded figure. The background features detailed line work showing the two figures interacting, surrounded by plants or foliage. The style resembles woodcuts with rich textures and cross-hatching, giving it a Renaissance or Gothic appearance.

artworks.title: Letter X
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures seated around a table with a crossed element overlaying them. The image depicts various figures gathered at a table. The figures are rendered in a black and white style, resembling medieval woodcuts. The scene is encapsulated in a square border, and the cross adds an element to the scene. The expressions and postures of the figures convey a sense of drama or tension.

artworks.title: Letter Y
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the letter 'Y' surrounded by intricate illustrations. The image showcases an ornate depiction of the letter 'Y' at the center. On the left side, there is a figure resembling a skeleton holding a scythe. On the right, another figure appears to be clutching the skeleton. The image is detailed with fine lines reminiscent of woodcuts or engravings. The background consists of horizontal lines adding depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: Letter Z
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is an image of an ornate letter "Z" surrounded by various figures and celestial imagery. The central focus is the large, decorative "Z", which is filled with intricate line work. Around this, several figures are depicted, some of which appear to be seated on a globe, while others are within the clouds. There are arrays of lines and geometric shapes intertwining with the human figures. The setting appears mythological or allegorical in nature, with a blend of earthly and otherworldly elements.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures, both visible from the waist up. The central figure is seated and is positioned in profile, facing to the left. This figure appears to be an older man with a prominent, long beard and a full head of hair. He is draped in a classical style robe that covers one shoulder and falls around his torso. His right hand is extended, holding a quill poised above a writing surface. Behind him, slightly to the left, is another figure, possibly a child or young angel, standing and looking intently at the seated man. This figure holds a cup and is partially obscured by the man's shoulder. The young figure has curly hair. A large wing is visible protruding behind the elder figure. The background includes drapery. On the right-hand side, a panel contains text with Latin script.

artworks.title: Saint Mark
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a beard seated in a contemplative posture. He is depicted in ancient or classical attire and holds a cylindrical scroll in his left hand while his right hand is raised with an extended index finger. A lion is next to him, and there is a decorative architectural element behind him. An inscription is visible on a feature on the right side of the image. In the background, there are arched structures and a castle-like building.

artworks.title: Saint Luke
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man shown from head to toe. He is positioned in a thoughtful manner, holding a square object with a compass in his right hand, pointing towards a small framed figure on a wall. The man has distinct facial features with a strong nose, a full beard, and wavy hair mostly covered by a beret-style cap. He is garbed in flowing robes with layered fabric. A cow sits at his feet. He is surrounded by various items, including a large, jug-like container and another object. A text panel with Latin script is on the wall. The background features wooden structures and a shelf.

artworks.title: Saint John
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated and writing, with curly hair and a draped garment. They hold a book and a stylus or quill pen. A large dog is beside them. In the background, to the right, there is a mother holding a child, both surrounded by light. To the left, a tree is visible. Below, there is a framed inscription with text in a script.

artworks.title: Crest
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate coat of arms featuring a central shield adorned with intricate decorative elements. At the top of the shield, there is a stylized, pointed star, and above the star, there is an empty ribbon. Within the shield, there is an armored hand. Surrounding the shield are elaborate accoutrements, including cascading acanthus leaves and foliage. Beneath the shield is a blank ribbon or scroll. The design showcases bold, flowing lines and detailed etching.

artworks.title: Crest
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coat of arms design. The central shield features three diamond shapes and a crescent element. Surrounding the shield are elaborate flourishes, scrolling vines, and decorative patterns, all rendered in a highly detailed manner using line work. Above the shield, there is a helmet resembling a knight's helm, supported by the surrounding ornate scrolls. The entire composition is framed by a scrolling line pattern. At the bottom of the composition, there is an open banner.

artworks.title: Crest
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic emblem. The image shows a centaur-like figure holding a bow and arrow, with leaves around its head. Below, there is a shield divided into two sections: the upper part shows shapes resembling birds, while the lower part shows a hound-like animal in a running pose. The shield is surrounded by swirling acanthus-like leaves, with additional decorative elements and a blank scroll space below it.

artworks.title: Crest
artworks.description: This is an image of an ornate coat of arms. The central element is a shield adorned with three pairs of round-bottomed flasks and a star near the top center. Above the shield are decorative plumes and swirls forming a helmet-like structure, with extending flourishes. These flourishes are embellished with ornamental scrolls and lines. At the top of the image, there is an unfurled ribbon banner left empty. Below the shield, there is another ribbon design serving as a base for the coat of arms. The base is signed "Blondus fecit." The style reflects traditional heraldic art with intricate detail and structured elegance.

artworks.title: Crest
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coat of arms. The image features a heraldic shield divided into four sections, each bearing different symbols: two crowns, a crescent moon, and three diamonds. Above the shield is a helmet, surrounded by elaborate scrollwork and foliage. Atop the helmet is a cluster of grapes with leaves. Above, a flowing ribbon provides a decorative touch, while a blank scroll at the bottom awaits an inscription. The drawing is intricate and richly detailed, emphasizing the tradition and artistry of heraldic designs.

artworks.title: Crest
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic coat of arms. The drawing features a detailed coat of arms set against a blank background. At the center of the coat of arms is a shield displaying a bird perched above three stylized roses with long stems. Above the shield, a crest of acanthus leaves forms around a helmet topped by a bird. Surrounding the shield is a decorative banner at the top, with flowing fabric or ribbons at the bottom. The line work and shading create a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: Crest
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate coat of arms. It features an intricate coat of arms, surrounded by elaborate flourishes and scrollwork. At the top, there is a cluster of grapes with two leaves above a shield containing three chalice-like shapes. The shield's border is decorated with foliage. Below the shield, there is a banner for potential text or a motto. The design shows high contrast and detailed work, signed by "Blondus fecit" in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Dance of Death I
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in an artwork. On the left is a skeletal figure playing a drum. In the center and to the right, a man and a woman are standing close to each other. The woman wears a detailed dress and a feathered hat, looking serious. The man wears a robe and a plumed hat, with a bushy beard and mustache. A small dog resembling a lion sniffs the ground on the bottom left. The background shows a small townscape with a clock tower against a partially cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Dance of Death II
artworks.description: The image shows three figures: a man, a woman, and a skeleton, all depicted in full length. The man wears a fur hat, fur-trimmed cloak, knee-high boots, and armor. The woman wears a gown with puffy sleeves and decorative patterns, with elaborate hair and a jeweled headdress. The skeleton plays a musical instrument and holds a mallet. In the background is a small village with buildings under a lightly shaded sky. An hourglass is placed at the skeleton’s feet.

artworks.title: Dance of Death III
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting three figures shown in full length. On the left stands a skeletal figure draped in a long cloak holding a lantern in its right hand and has a cloth wrapped around its head. The center figure is a woman, with a gentle, rounded facial structure and styled in an updo, adorned with a laurel wreath-like accessory. She wears a long, flowing gown with intricate detailing around the neckline and a belt, and her robe has a decorative brooch. To the right stands a bearded man with pronounced facial hair. He wears a large, feathered hat and an outfit featuring a doublet with bulbous sleeves and decorative fastenings. He carries a falcon on his left arm covered with a protective glove. The background shows architectural silhouettes of buildings against a clear sky.

artworks.title: Dance of Death IV
artworks.description: This is an illustration featuring three figures shown from head to toe. The central figure is a skeletal person with flower-like growths on its head, engaged in physical contact with the other two figures. To the left is a woman in historical attire with long, wavy hair and a soft facial expression. She wears a puffed-sleeve dress adorned with a small round pendant and carries bulbs or fabric balls attached to her dress. To the right, a bearded man, also in historical clothing, stands holding a decorative stick with an hourglass attached. His attire includes puffed sleeves and loose trousers. The background is minimally detailed, focusing on the interaction among the figures and features a patterned floor.

artworks.title: Dance of Death V
artworks.description: The image displays three figures side by side. The left figure is skeletal with a jester's outfit. The center figure is robed with curly hair, looking towards the jester. The right figure wears a regal dress and a crown. The background features small mounds and vegetation, along with initials and a design in the upper portion of the image.

artworks.title: Dance of Death VI
artworks.description: The image shows three figures standing together. In the center, there is a woman wearing a detailed gown with puffed sleeves, a high collar, and jewelry. She has a focused expression and wears a headpiece. On her left is a skeletal figure, symbolizing Death, dressed in a skirt and feathered hat, holding a sword and hourglass. On her right stands an older man with a beard, bald head, tunic, and puffy trousers, holding a cane. The background is subtly engraved without distinct features.

artworks.title: Fameio (Servant)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing sideways while holding a large urn-like object with both hands. The individual has shoulder-length hair and is dressed in a short tunic with decorative trimmings. They appear barefoot and the background features a simple design with a framed border.

artworks.title: Artixan (Artisan)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a workshop interior. It shows various tools and a fireplace. On the left, there is a fire burning in a small enclosed fireplace with a rotating spit and items roasting. A table on the right displays tools like compasses and rulers. The ceiling consists of closely-aligned wooden planks, and a narrow shelf on the wall holds small vessels and jars.

artworks.title: Merchadante (Merchant)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person standing upright. The person is holding a piece of paper or parchment with both hands in front of them and is depicted with their head slightly tilted downward. The facial features are smooth and simple, with a calm expression. The hair is hidden under a cloth headpiece that extends down to the shoulders. The individual is wearing a long, flowing robe with wide sleeves, which is belted at the waist. The robe is adorned with vertical lines. The person is standing within a border that appears to frame the image. The background is plain and unadorned, with a simple textured floor beneath the person's feet. At the bottom of the image, the inscription "MERCHADANTE IIII" is written.
